findings.label: Reopen-to-pending skips uniqueness
findings.detail: Setting a cancelled or expired invitation back to 'pending' via the editable sidebar status select now skips the pending-duplicate and user-exists checks, which the old validator applied. Consider re-checking when status moves from non-pending to pending, or making status read-only in the admin.

findings.label: GET catch doesn't classify ValidationError
findings.detail: A ValidationError in the GET catch is now logged but still returns 500. That path should no longer fail. Optionally mirror the POST 400 mapping.

findings.label: Admin form-state path untested
findings.detail: The validator's findByID fallback (when previousValue is absent) and the /:id/resend HTTP endpoint were only covered by direct payload.update calls. Smoke-test editing an invitation and Resend in the admin panel around deploy.
